name: CascaderField
description:
Cascader bound to a form field: a path (`string[] | null`), or `string[][]` with
`multiple`. Use it inside `form.AppField`; label, hint and the first error come from the field.
signature: ({ label, hint, warning, optional, required, aside, className, disabled, multiple, wrap, ...control }: CascaderFieldProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when a visible label does not name the control.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: IDs of elements that provide the accessible name.

props.name: aside
props.description: Right side of the label row: a live value readout or a small link.

props.name: changeOnSelect
props.description: Single choice: any level can be chosen, not only the last. Choosing a level also opens it.

props.name: checkStrategy
props.description:
Multiple choice: which checked paths the value lists. `parent` (default) lists a fully
checked level instead of everything under it; `child` lists last levels only; `all` lists both.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: hint
props.description: The message line's resting text. Only when the format or consequence is not obvious (R2.8).

props.name: icon
props.description: A fixed leading icon in the trigger.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable element or component identifier.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the control. Omit only when a group legend or `aria-label` names it instead.

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<{ placeholder: string; options: string; search: string; separator: string; noMatch: (query: string) => string; moreMatches: (shown: number, total: number) => string; matches: (count: number) => string; back: string; selected: (count: number) => string; more: (count: number, labels: string) => string; clear: string; loading: string; loadFailed: string; retry: string; }> | undefined
props.description: Wording for this instance, over the language pack and `MessagesProvider`.

props.name: layout
props.description:
columns: levels side by side. list: one level at a time with a Back button, in a popup
as wide as the screen allows. auto (default): list on phone-sized viewports.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for search matching and wording. Default: the nearest `LocaleProvider`.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Several paths, with checkboxes. Bind it to a `string[][]` field; a single path binds to `string[] | null`.

props.name: onLoadChildren
props.type: ((option: CascaderOption, path: string[]) => Promise<void> | void) | undefined
props.description:
Load a level the first time it opens (an option with `hasChildren` and no `children`):
update `options`, then resolve. Receives the option and its value path. A rejection shows Retry.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with true when the popup opens and false when it closes.

props.name: optional
props.description: Marks the label "Optional". Prefer this over marking required fields.

props.name: options
props.description: The hierarchy: each level a short list (country → region → site). Values are unique among siblings.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while nothing is chosen. Name the choice ("Choose a site").

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Displays the current value without allowing edits.

props.name: ref
props.description: Receives the underlying element for focus or measurement. React 19 accepts ref as a normal prop.

props.name: required
props.description: Shows the required marker. Pass `required` to the control as well.

props.name: searchable
props.description: Show a search field that lists matching full paths. Default true.

props.name: searchLimit
props.description: The most search results listed; the rest are counted. Default 50.

props.name: size
props.description: The token-based size. Touch targets adapt to coarse pointers independently of the selected density.

props.name: warning
props.description: Non-blocking warning in the reserved message slot; errors take precedence.

props.name: width
props.description: Content width: short, medium or full (default).

props.name: wrap
props.description: Multiple choice: let chips wrap onto more lines (forms).

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Whether the component should ignore user interaction.
Takes precedence over the `disabled` prop on the `<Field.Control>` component.
